title: Rust-owned Java baseline extraction
description: Implement the Java item from docs/prds/2026-07-03-rust-owned-migration-roadmap.md via roadmap-sliced-development-pattern.

1-1.label: Java ownership contract and baseline gap inventory

decisions.answer: Migrate baseline Java extraction into Rust-owned per-file indexing: package/module, class/interface/annotation/enum/enum member, methods/constructors, fields/local variables, imports, and method invocation unresolved references. Keep Spring/Play framework resolver semantics in the TypeScript shell for this PR.
decisions.note: Gate: inventory records current TS extractor contract and Rust ownership gaps before implementation. Commit intent: docs/plans roadmap checkpoint plus code inventory evidence.

1-1.notes: Gate passed. Evidence: src/extraction/languages/java.ts currently owns Java baseline extraction as a thin tree-sitter config; crates/zcodegraph-core/src/lib.rs SourceLanguage lacks Java; src/indexing/rust-hybrid-contract.ts does not list java as Rust-owned. Scope decision: migrate baseline extraction only; keep Spring/Play framework semantics in TS shell.

1-2.label: Rust-owned Java baseline implementation
1-2.notes: Gate passed. Rust core now registers SourceLanguage::Java, uses tree-sitter-java, and extracts package/module, class, interface, annotation type, enum, enum_member, constructors/methods, annotation elements, fields/local variables, imports, and method_invocation unresolved calls. Verification: cargo build --package zcodegraph-core; npx vitest run __tests__/rust-index-engine-cli-language-smoke.test.ts.

1-3.label: Rust-hybrid Java ownership contract switch
1-3.notes: Gate passed. src/indexing/rust-hybrid-contract.ts now lists java as Rust-owned. Targeted smoke asserts buildInfo.hybrid.rustOwnedLanguages includes java, engineByLanguage.java is rust, fallbackByLanguage is empty, and fallbackFileCount is 0 for a Java-only project. Verification: npm run build; npx vitest run __tests__/rust-index-engine-cli-language-smoke.test.ts.

1-4.label: Java fixture and contract verification
1-4.notes: Gate passed. Added Java smoke fixture with package, import, interface, class, constructor, methods, field, local variable, enum/member, annotation type/element, and qualifiedName assertion for Service::assist. Verification: npx vitest run __tests__/rust-index-engine-cli-language-smoke.test.ts passed 18 tests.

1-5.label: GitHub Java corpus validation
1-5.notes: Gate: one suitably sized GitHub Java project indexes successfully with rust-hybrid, Java files are Rust-owned, and validation notes are recorded. Commit intent: docs: record rust-owned java corpus validation.

1-6.label: Remove TypeScript Java fallback extractor
1-6.notes: Gate passed. Removed src/extraction/languages/java.ts and removed javaExtractor from EXTRACTORS. Kept grammar/extension detection so .java files are still recognized and routed to Rust-owned indexing. Verification: npm run build; npx vitest run __tests__/rust-index-engine-cli-language-smoke.test.ts passed 18 tests.

1-7.label: Roadmap closeout and PR handoff
1-7.notes: Gate: decisions are audited, durable docs updated, process roadmap either deleted or explicitly retained, branch pushed, PR opened with verification notes. Commit intent: docs: close out rust-owned java support.
